scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && gh-pages -d dist -b gh-pages
scripts.build:server: esbuild src/server/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=server-dist/main.mjs && esbuild src/server/releaseProof.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=server-dist/releaseProof.mjs && esbuild src/server/digitalProof.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=server-dist/digitalProof.mjs && esbuild src/server/seedGroupAssets.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=server-dist/seedGroupAssets.mjs
scripts.typecheck:server: tsc --noEmit --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --target ES2022 --lib ES2022,DOM --skipLibCheck --types node src/server/main.ts src/server/seedGroupAssets.ts src/server/digitalProof.ts
